scope: Module preamble, five progress/loading procedures and five selection/legacy serializer procedures; source-only local semantic review.

dependency_interface_review.finding: Time conversions and dynamic engine loader callers are native bridge interfaces; legacy and additive serializers share selection when additive output enabled.
Candidate/Reset native schemas and presentation clone own geometry; serialization does not rediscover trading events.
BlueLine has Decimal prices and optional Fibonacci/broken levels; legacy serializer omits internal validity metadata.
AZone has separate trigger event timestamp and optional presentation provenance; legacy serializer does not emit optional route or Blue stop event timestamps.

findings.detail: Progress and timing exception ordering: started notification occurs outside protected work; finally completion occurs even for work failure, and cleanup failure may supersede original exception.
Dynamic loader inserts module before execution and has no rollback; import bootstrap only inserts exact path if absent.
Index selection bypasses int conversion if either bound absent; Reaction filter uses original First index before transformation; non-null selected_items bypasses reselection.
Legacy Reaction and Reset output keeps input order and exact str price representation; unguarded Break time conversion requires valid candidate.
Blue filters source index only and omits native internal flags; A maps existing items without local filtering, sets calculationValid true and preserves distinct trigger/event times.

documentation_changes: One source-pinned clarification section appended to Bridge documentation; no production changes.
limitations: No independent full current canonical AST replay; exact historical source spans and CP287/CP292 anchored complements support scoped acceptance.
Remaining-owner intervals are source grouping, not full runtime ownership proof.
